editorial:
Ever wish you could go back and fix your biggest mistakes? That's exactly what happens to Mike O'Donnell, a tired dad stuck in a rut who suddenly finds himself 17 again. With his adult brain trapped in a teenage body, he heads back to high school and gets a second shot at the life he thought he ruined. The vibe is light, funny, and surprisingly sweet, mixing classic high school comedy with a heartfelt family story. Zac Efron brings tons of charm to the younger Mike, while Matthew Perry grounds the older version with real regret. You'll laugh at the awkward situations and maybe even feel a little tug at your heart.

The standout here is Efron's energy and comic timing, plus a strong supporting cast that keeps the jokes landing. The pacing moves quickly, so you never get bored, though some jokes feel a bit predictable and the fantasy setup is pretty silly if you think too hard. Still, the emotional beats land well and the family moments feel genuine. If you enjoy feel-good comedies with a little heart, this one's a great pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Mike realizes his past choices weren't mistakes at all and that his family matters most. He gives up his second chance at youth to return to his adult life, fixing things with his wife and kids. The twist is that his best friend Ned, who helped him through the whole adventure, ends up with the school principal. Mike learns you can't rewrite your past, but you can choose to be better today.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves feel-good comedies with heart and a little fantasy magic.
